'''Erinn Bonette''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rogue CorSec|Rogue]] [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Bonette and fellow Rogue CorSec officer [[Echdo Bervekk]] worked with another criminal, the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] lieutenant [[Kaiya Merel]]. Merel dispatched a new Meatlump recruit to help them hijack a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. However, the Meatlump recruit was in fact a spacer working for the ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Vani Korr]] who was investigating the Meatlumps. The spacer met the two Rogue CorSec officers near [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] and attacked them. Erinn Bonette and Echdo Bervekk were killed in the confrontation.<ref name="SWG:TMHP6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Erinn Bonette appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP6" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Erinn Bonette was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>

This non-player character (NPC) was known in the game as either '''Erinn Bonette''' or '''Berinn Ebonette''', depending of the Combat Level (CL) of the player. If the player performed the quest "[[W:c:swg:The Meatlumps Hideout|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 6]]" during the leveling of their character (at CL 65), the NPC would be named Erinn Bonette. If the player performed the quest after the end of the game (at CL 90), the NPC would be named Berinn Ebonette. Multiple story elements indicated that the quest was intended to be achieved at CL 65.<ref name="SWG:TMHP6" />
